title: Homepage loads and displays core landing sections
description: Verifies the homepage renders the hero and key merchandising sections users expect to see above and below the fold.

steps.description: Verify text "Rings by Style" is visible

title: CTA from homepage navigates into collection and shows product grid
description: Verifies the primary call-to-action on the homepage sends users to the collection browsing experience with a visible product grid.

steps.description: Click on the "Shop" or "Explore Collection" CTA button

title: Browse Rings by Style section is reachable and populated
description: Verifies users can reach the Rings by Style section and see style options they can interact with.

steps.description: Verify text "Rings by Style" is visible
Click on the first visible style card

title: Browse Diamond Shapes section is reachable and populated
description: Verifies users can view the Diamond Shapes section and interact with a diamond shape option to start browsing products.

steps.description: Verify element "Diamond shape options" is visible
Click on the first visible diamond shape option

title: Browse Categories section is visible and a category click leads to collection
description: Verifies category merchandising is visible on the homepage and selecting a category moves the user into product browsing.

steps.description: Click on the first visible category card

title: Featured products show a loading state then render product cards

Click on the first visible featured product card
Verify element "Add to cart" is visible

title: Testimonials section is readable and displays testimonial content
description: Verifies social proof content is present and visible on the homepage.

Fill "ValidPass123!" into the confirm password field

description: Verifies the signup success page presents a visible confirmation to the user after registration.

description: Verifies the form validates email format and displays an error for an invalid email address.

Fill "ValidPass123!" into the confirm password field

title: Sort products by price from the sort dropdown
description: Verifies that selecting a price-based sort option updates the visible ordering of products.

steps.description: Select the "Price: Low to High" option from the sort list
Verify text "Price: Low to High" is visible

title: Search filters results live from the search field
description: Verifies that typing a query in the collection search field updates the displayed products.

title: Quick View opens and allows Add to Cart from the modal
description: Verifies that Quick View opens a modal and adding to cart from within it updates the cart indicator/state visibly.

steps.description: Click on "Quick View" for the first visible product
Verify element "Quick View" modal is visible
Click on "Add to Cart" in the Quick View modal
Verify text "Added to cart" is visible

title: Pagination navigates through product pages
description: Verifies that using pagination changes the visible product list and indicates the active page.

steps.description: Click on "Next" in the pagination controls
Click on page number "2" in the pagination controls

title: Add product to wishlist from collection card
description: Verifies that a product can be added to the wishlist from the collection view and the UI reflects the change.

steps.description: Click on "Add to wishlist" (heart icon) for the first visible product
Verify text "Added to wishlist" is visible
Click on "Add to wishlist" (heart icon) for the same product again
Verify text "Removed from wishlist" is visible

title: Product image gallery updates main image when selecting thumbnails
description: Verifies that clicking different image thumbnails updates the main product image on the Product Detail page.

steps.description: Click on the first visible product card in the product grid
Verify element "Main product image" is visible
Click on the second visible image thumbnail in the gallery
Verify element "Main product image" is visible
Click on the third visible image thumbnail in the gallery
Verify element "Main product image" is visible

title: 3D model viewer opens and closes from Product Detail page
description: Verifies the 3D model viewer can be opened and then closed from the Product Detail page.

steps.description: Click on the first visible product card in the product grid
Click on the "3D" or "View in 3D" control
Verify element "3D model viewer" is visible
Click on the "Close" control in the 3D model viewer
Verify element "3D model viewer" is not visible

title: Select a variant/size and add product to cart shows confirmation
description: Verifies a user can select a variant or size and add the item to cart with a visible confirmation.

steps.description: Click on the first visible product card in the product grid
Verify text "Add to Cart" is visible
Select an available option from the "Size" or "Variant" dropdown
Click on the "Add to Cart" button
Verify text "Added to cart" is visible
Click on the cart icon in the header

title: Add to cart without selecting required variant shows validation message
description: Verifies the page blocks adding to cart when a required size/variant is not selected and shows a visible message.

steps.description: Click on the first visible product card in the product grid
Verify text "Add to Cart" is visible
Click on the "Add to Cart" button

title: Add product to wishlist shows wishlist confirmation
description: Verifies clicking Add to Wishlist shows a visible confirmation on the Product Detail page.

steps.description: Click on the first visible product card in the product grid
Verify text "Add to Wishlist" is visible
Click on the "Add to Wishlist" button
Verify text "Added to wishlist" is visible

title: Out-of-stock product shows error when attempting to add to cart
description: Verifies an out-of-stock product cannot be added to cart and a visible out-of-stock error message is shown.

steps.description: Scroll to the bottom of the product grid
Click on a product card that visibly indicates "Out of stock"
Verify text "Out of stock" is visible
Click on the "Add to Cart" button
Verify text "Out of stock" is visible
Verify text "cannot be added" is visible

title: Product details section is visible and readable on Product Detail page
description: Verifies that core product information (title, price, description/details) is visible on the Product Detail page.

steps.description: Click on the first visible product card in the product grid
Verify element "Product description text" is visible

title: Related products section is visible and navigable from Product Detail page
description: Verifies that related products are shown and a user can navigate to a related product from the Product Detail page.

steps.description: Click on the first visible product card in the product grid
Click on the first visible related product card
Verify text "Add to Cart" is visible

title: Required shipping fields show visible validation when left blank
description: Verifies checkout shows visible validation feedback when attempting to proceed without completing required shipping information.

steps.description: Click into the "Full name" field in the shipping address form

title: Access account dashboard and view profile + order history
description: Verifies an authenticated user can open the account dashboard and see profile information and order history.

description: Verifies an authenticated user can edit profile details and sees a visible confirmation after saving.

steps.description: Fill "Updated Test Name" into the "Name" field

title: Logout from account redirects to login

description: Verifies the login page shows a visible error when the user enters an incorrect password.

title: Account dashboard shows empty-state message when no orders exist
description: Verifies the order history section shows a clear empty state when the user has no orders.

title: Book an appointment successfully with valid date, time, type, and contact info
description: Verifies a user can submit a valid appointment booking request and see a confirmation on success.

title: Prevent submission when a required contact field is empty
description: Verifies required-field validation blocks submission and displays an error message when a required contact field is missing.

steps.description: Verify text "Email is required" is visible

title: Prevent submission when appointment type is not selected
description: Verifies the user must choose an appointment type before submitting and sees a validation error if omitted.

description: Verifies the user cannot submit a booking without selecting an appointment date and sees a validation message.

steps.description: Verify text "Date is required" is visible

title: Prevent submission when time is not selected after choosing a date
description: Verifies the user cannot submit a booking without selecting a time and sees a validation message.

steps.description: Verify text "Time is required" is visible

title: Changing the selected date updates available times and prevents using an invalid previous time
description: Verifies that when a user changes the appointment date, the time selection reflects availability and the user is prompted to choose a valid time.

Verify text "Select appointment time" is visible
Verify text "Time is required" is visible

Type "ring" into the header search input

Type "diamond" into the header search input

Click on "Shop" (or "Collection") in the mobile menu

Type "zzzxqvnonexistent" into the header search input
